name: KEY CONTROL
author: izicubed
description: Physical two-key USB button keyboards as per-pilot lap marshals. Each keyboard controls one seat of the running race: key 1 adds a lap manually (same as the Run page '+ Lap' button), key 2 deletes that seat's last recorded lap. Keyboards are read by a small forwarder script on a remote Raspberry Pi (or the timer itself) and forwarded to the server over Socket.IO. Keyboard N maps to the Nth occupied seat of the current heat by default (e.g. with pilots on R1, R3, R6, R8: keyboard 1 -> R1, keyboard 2 -> R3, ...), with per-keyboard fixed-seat overrides. Run-page panel shows live keyboard-to-pilot mapping and forwarder link status.
